subject: DPA + SCCs: UK-only hosting carveout for Private deployment

Cc: ClearShield Legal <legal@clearshield.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: DPA + SCCs: UK-only hosting carveout for Private deployment

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're progressing internally and procurement asked for a clear path on data residency and transfers for our UK business unit. Two asks from Legal/InfoSec:

1) Can Redwood Private be scoped to UK-only hosting (physical and logical separation) for a specific environment? If yes, we need a short clause or carveout in the DPA/Order Form.
2) We need redlines on the DPA and the SCCs (we'll want to add a UK-specific SCC note given the new framework) — I've attached the latest Order Form for reference.

Timing: procurement is targeting a signed contract by EOM Nov. Could you send over your proposed redlines and a short note on technical controls (KMS, export controls, SFTP/export restrictions)?

Appreciate it — Emma

--
Emma Carter
Senior Procurement Manager | ClearShield Health
emma@clearshield.com
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: ClearShield_OrderForm_v2.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma@clearshield.com>
Cc: ClearShield Legal <legal@clearshield.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs: UK-only hosting carveout for Private deployment

Emma — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Legal and Contracts (Laura + Ben) to validate scope and proposed language.

Quick summary of what we can provide now:
- Redwood Private supports environment-level hosting constraints; we can commit to UK-region-only hosting for a dedicated private deployment and document that in the Order Form.
- Technical controls: we can offer customer-managed KMS (BYOK) or Redwood-managed KMS with UK key storage on request; export controls: we avoid cross-border exports from the UK environment unless explicitly requested by the customer through an approved change process.

I'm attaching our initial redline of the DPA and an annotated SCCs memo — these are working drafts and will need Legal sign-off. Request to Laura/Ben: please prioritize review for (1) wording to lock hosting scope in the Order Form, (2) any issues with processor/controller roles in the DPA, and (3) whether we need to involve external counsel for UK adequacy/representative language.

Proposed next steps for Emma/ClearShield:
- We (Redwood) propose to send a redlined DPA + short Order Form addendum by EOD tomorrow.
- If ClearShield wants, we can set a 30-min call with Legal to walk through the carveout language.

Diego
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com

Attachments: DPA_redline_diego_v1.docx; SCCs_annotation_notes.pdf

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs: UK-only hosting carveout for Private deployment

Diego / Ben — reviewing now. High-level guidance and suggested approach below, will follow with inline redlines in the draft DPA.

Principles:
- Prefer Order Form addendum that references the DPA rather than changing baseline DPA text extensively. Keeps main DPA standard across customers while permitting location-specific commitments.
- Keep processor/controller definitions consistent; avoid creating an atypical hybrid unless ClearShield insists.
- For UK-specific SCCs/adequacy: recommend we involve external counsel (Ashley Thompson) for a short opinion on whether the proposed clause and SCC mapping are sufficient under the UK framework.

Immediate asks for Contracts/Eng:
- Ben: please prepare a one-paragraph Order Form addendum that: (a) confirms UK-region-only hosting for the named environment; (b) references that keys for KMS will be stored in the UK if customer chooses BYOK; (c) requires written customer authorization for any export or cross-border data movement.
- Diego: can you confirm the technical controls/ops runbook we will provide as supporting material (SFTP/export block list, logging/audit evidence, KMS key residency options)? I can include that as an exhibit link instead of in the DPA body.

External counsel: Ashley — copying you as optional. If you can confirm availability for a short review this week, we can route a redline for your opinion (hourly capped).

I'll upload inline redlines to the Drive link Diego shared and create a clean Order Form addendum for Ben to iterate on.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

1) Attachments/links: I've published the redline to the shared Drive (link below) and attached a one-page technical controls summary (SCCs annotation + KMS options).
2) Legal path: Laura will provide inline redlines to the DPA and propose a one-paragraph Order Form addendum. Ben will draft the addendum language by tomorrow morning.
